summary: Frontend-only verification of new Posting page + Make-up payment modal + Monthly Fees short/late display. All primary assertions passed non-destructively. Login as treasurer works, Posting page loads with correct stats, unit 601 toggle round-trip restored data to Paid, make-up modal totals match spec ($72 for 607, $48 for 613), modal closed without submitting, short badges and Short(rate) stat remain intact after close.

issues: React hydration/DOM warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' from MakeupModal.jsx (line ~59). Cosmetic only, but should be cleaned up — option text should be plain string, not a wrapped <span> with dynamic attributes.

posting_page.unit_601_toggle_flow: Paid -> click -> 'Mark paid' (stat 9/10) -> click -> 'Paid' (stat 10/10). Non-destructive: fully restored.

makeup_modal.note: No elements matched selector [data-testid^='makeup-month-']. The per-month list may render via different testid/naming; totals still verify correctness. Main agent may want to add testids like makeup-month-{ym} for future regression.

fees_page_post_close.apply-late-fee_context: Unit 601 (Paid on Jul 16, past the 10th) shows 'Late — Apply $30.00'. Paid-on-time rows correctly show '—'. No crash.

action_items: Fix React hydration warning in /app/frontend/src/components/MakeupModal.jsx — <option> children should be plain text, not <span>. This is likely caused by inline JSX with data-testid attributes injected onto option content.
(Nice-to-have) Add data-testid="makeup-month-{unitId}-{yyyy-mm}" on each row of the shortfall month list so future tests can enumerate the 6 months (Jul–Dec 2026).
critical_code_review_comments: Make-up modal renders <span> inside <option>, invalid HTML — cosmetic but should be corrected.
seed_data_creation: None. Non-destructive test: 601 toggle round-tripped to Paid, make-up modal closed without submit, no PUT/POST mutations to fee data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Posting page + make-up modal + late-fee manual column verified end-to-end. If retesting, unit 607 shortfall=$72, unit 613=$48 for July 2026. Unit 601 is paid on Jul 16 so an apply-late-fee-601 button renders. The 'Late—Apply' badge is treated as apply-late-fee button per data-testid prefix match.
